name: HHKB Studio (Bluetooth)
notes: 225-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real HHKB Studio, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://github.com/iberianpig/fusuma-plugin-thumbsense/blob/61a7feaaa1d3de2b55006ffd848ef0dac6f3f824/spec/fusuma/plugin/inputs/hhkb_studio_bluetooth.txt#L114-L114. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
